welcome.title: Welcome to CraftBot
welcome.description: Here is a quick tour of the essentials. It takes about a minute.

chat-composer.title: Talk to CraftBot
chat-composer.description: Type anything here: a question, a task, attach files, or a whole project. Communicate with CraftBot like you would with human over text messages.

main-session.title: Your Main chat
main-session.description: Main is the agent's home chat: it can't be deleted or renamed, and anything that happens on its own (like scheduled tasks or updates from connected apps) arrives here.

agent-app.title: Agent App apps
agent-app.description: Ask CraftBot to build you a real app (a tracker, a CRM, a dashboard) and it appears here, built and running. There are three ways to add one:

living-ui-marketplace.title: Marketplace
living-ui-marketplace.description: Install a ready-made app from the community marketplace with a single click.

agent-app-custom.title: Create Custom
agent-app-custom.description: Describe what you want and the agent builds it: configure a few basics, answer a short interview, then it writes the spec and builds the app.

agent-app-import.title: Import
agent-app-import.description: Bring in an existing Agent App from a ZIP, a folder, or a git URL.

dashboard.title: CraftBot Dashboard
dashboard.description: A live control room for CraftBot, tracking usage, activity, and system health.

memory.title: CraftBot memory
memory.description: Everything CraftBot learns about you and your work lives here as a browsable graph of memories, entities, and files. The more you use CraftBot, the better it remembers you.

workspace.title: CraftBot workspace
workspace.description: CraftBot's dedicated file system. Browse the files your agent reads and writes, and upload your own.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure your agent here. A few areas worth knowing:

settings-proactive.title: Proactive
settings-proactive.description: Let your agent work on its own: run scheduled tasks and react to events without being asked.

settings-skills.title: Skills
settings-skills.description: Add reusable capabilities so your agent knows how to carry out specific tasks.

settings-integrations.title: Integrations
settings-integrations.description: Connect apps like Gmail, Calendar, and Notion so your agent can work across them.

done.title: You're all set
done.description: That is the end of this tour. Start giving CraftBot tasks to work for you.
